name: act
description: Discover and use the current machine's act installation for local GitHub Actions validation and debugging.

interface.shortDescription: Run suitable GitHub Actions jobs on this machine.
interface.longDescription: Discover the installed act command, configuration, and container runtime before selecting and running authorized local CI jobs. Diagnose setup and compatibility gaps without changing shared services.
defaultPrompt: Use act to run this repository's Linux test job locally.
Check whether this machine can run our pull-request checks with act.
Debug this CI failure locally and distinguish workflow errors from act gaps.
